answer: The protocol requires each agent to store 1,000 unique data shards to ensure distinct utility within the grove. A verifier emits a signal for unpredictable shard retrieval, and an agent must produce the hash within a tight deadline. While an honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost because every raven must hold unique shards. Failure to provide proof leads to an immediate slash.
